name: vampire weaknesses
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has the following flaws:
Forbiddance. the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.
Harmed by Running Water. the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water.
Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s heart while the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is incapacitated in its resting place, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is paralyzed until the stake is removed.
Sunlight Hypersensitivity. the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.
